profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and delivered the complete technology stack using .NET, SQL Server, Redis, Docker, and AWS, enabling rapid deployment and foundational infrastructure for the organization.
- Delivered a resilient message-handling architecture that scaled seamlessly by adding servers, utilizing containerization, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure for high availability.
- Developed monitoring applications in .NET and AWS for production operations that analyzed architecture health and directed corrective actions, such as addressing major K-means clustering errors for system reliability.
- Introduced CI/CD pipelines utilizing industry-standard tooling to streamline the software deployment process, promoting rapid iteration and code reliability.
- Transformed high-level product concepts into concrete backend systems, utilizing C#, Redis, and Docker, while ensuring alignment with user expectations and business priorities.
- Participated in Conexxus to gather insights into upcoming technologies, ensuring alignment of technical strategy with industry standards and community discussions.
- Supported fundraising by delivering technology and scalability presentations to stakeholders, emphasizing architecture decisions and cloud infrastructure capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Datadog · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · Docker · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer and Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Facilitated migration of monolithic codebase to a microservice architecture by dissecting system dependencies and applying .NET Core best practices.
- Enhanced system observability by automating metric reporting to Datadog, enabling comprehensive visibility into performance trends across microservices.
- Created comprehensive technical documentation and Datadog dashboards to guide on-call teams in diagnosing and responding to irregular service behaviors using monitoring tools.
- Engineered resilient processing paths using C# and containerized environments, enabling graceful degradation instead of total system outage during message delivery slowdowns.
- Improved consistency and reliability of microservice deployment by centralizing Docker stack configurations and establishing source-controlled deployment paradigms using Docker and industry-standard VCS tools.
- Coordinated efforts to adapt backend infrastructure, using .NET Core and Java Spring, enabling seamless flow of Synovia data into Calamp’s systems.
- Expanded core feature sets by replicating critical functionalities from .NET Core applications in Java Spring environments using Java, Spring Framework, and Microservices architecture.
- Guided a cross-functional unit through quarterly milestone execution by planning tasks, distributing workload, and facilitating sync-ups throughout the Calamp and Synovia integration.
- Implemented containerization for Java Spring applications using Docker and wrote detailed process documentation to support cross-team adoption.
- Architected and deployed a high-throughput 'Here Comes the Bus' platform capable of processing upwards of 50,000 messages per second, leveraging scalable microservices and robust data pipelines to support real-time telematics operations.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a Xamarin Android application from inception using C# and Xamarin, applying iterative development practices to accommodate scaling requirements.
- Facilitated app scaling by developing modular features that allowed team members from diverse disciplines, including non-engineers, to contribute effectively to tailored product delivery.
- Maintained ongoing stability of the Xamarin iOS app by troubleshooting defects and implementing robust updates using Visual Studio and source control systems.
- Designed and implemented backend components for Xamarin mobile applications using C# and SQL Server to deliver core app functionality.
- Integrated Bamboo into the build process, streamlining the automation of app compilation and submission for continuous delivery using C# and Xamarin.
- Designed and developed RESTful APIs for mobile applications using C# and .NET, ensuring efficient data exchange and consistency across platforms.
- Created robust unit test suites for API endpoints utilizing tools such as NUnit and Moq, ensuring reliable validation of application logic.

positions.title: Website Application Developer
positions.description:
- Developed interactive web applications for leading brands using ActionScript, C#, and SQL Server, following project specifications and digital branding guidelines.
- Debugged and maintained ActionScript codebase for the Captain Crunch website, ensuring smooth operation and consistent performance across browsers.
- Modified and extended Sitefinity core functionalities by developing reusable components in C#, streamlining content management tasks for site administrators.
- Enhanced user interface components within the application by integrating modular Java frameworks, promoting intuitive functionality and maintainable code.

positions.description:

-Web or application development
